legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract is freely assignable by the Assignor to any third party without notice to or consent from the Seller. The Assignee hereby acknowledges and agrees to be bound by the terms and conditions of the Original Contract.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Assignee from and against any and all claims, demands, or causes of action arising from any breach or default of the Assignor under the Original Contract.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment of Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment of Contract shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations associated with the transfer of ownership, including but not limited to title insurance, transfer taxes, and recording fees.
